VALUE_1_TEXT: Do this evaluation as carefully as your work: if you choose 1, 2 or 5, write a real example that explains why.
VALUE_2_TEXT: Our intention is to help each other grow — no flattery and no blame.
VALUE_3_TEXT: Rate only what you have seen yourself. What you write is held in trust: the person you rate will not know it was you, only the evaluation admin sees individual answers, and your written notes may reach the person without your name — so write kindly, without details that reveal who you are.
VALUE_4_TEXT: Say what is true, clearly and kindly, the way you would like it said to you.
